name: 3d-navigation-kiosk
description: Futuristic 3D indoor navigation kiosk built with Three.js

notes.runtime: Three.js r162 loaded from CDN via importmap. For offline/production use, bundle with Vite.

positioning.ble: Requires Web Bluetooth (Chrome 79+, HTTPS). Real scanning via navigator.bluetooth.requestLEScan.
positioning.wifi: Requires backend agent at GET /api/positioning/wifi returning {x,z,floor,confidence}.
positioning.vps: Set window.VPS_ENDPOINT + window.VPS_TOKEN before init('vps'). Compatible with Immersal REST API.

notes.gltf: To load a real building model, call app.building.loadGLTF('/models/building.glb'). Mesh names must follow Floor_N_* convention.
